第一卷 第649章 我们问心无愧（第1页）
看到陆博士和台下众人的反应，叶秋雨笑意不减，但他眼神却是冷的，他直直地看着容辞，说道：“是啊，大家都知道不可能对吧？但偏偏有人就做、到、了！”
“做到了”三个字，叶秋雨是一字一顿地说的，脸上和语气里的讽刺毫不掩饰。
听到这里，大家自然都明白过来，叶秋雨是想告诉大家容辞进入长墨手段不正，她根本没有大家以为那么优秀，她发表的那些论文也根本不是出自她的手笔。
容辞有没有大家以为那么优秀，只要不影响双方合作，似乎也跟外人没有太大关系。
要是容辞发表的那些论文，都是郁默勋自己或找他人代写的，可就涉及学术造假了。
有人忍不住说道：“其实，在容辞第一篇论文问世时，网上就已经有人质疑过她的实力。很多人觉得是郁默勋为了捧他女朋友给她代写的，但很多人也觉得郁默勋应该不会糊涂到这个地步，毕竟，他可是南院士正儿八经的学生啊，事情要是闹大了，别说是他，就是南院士都会受到一定影响。”
之前大家都觉得郁默勋不可能这么糊涂，可如果现在大家听到这里，如果刚才他们听到的都是真的，那郁默勋给容辞代笔写论文，似乎也不是不可能了……
至于容辞，他们是真的没想到她这么有野心有手段。
这时，有人忍不住说道：“原来郁默勋，容辞，林芜之间还存在这么一段过往，难怪先前陆博士还觉得奇怪，说为什么长墨和封氏明明合作了这么久，双方之间也合作得这么好，但封总和郁默勋之间关系似乎一直很淡漠，平时也基本上没什么来往，原来……”
“是啊，谁能想到他们之间还有这么一段恩怨呢？”
到了这里，大家其实都挺想知道郁默勋会怎么回应的。
这时，大家都看向了郁默勋，包括陆博士。
最后，也是陆博士开了口：“郁总。”顿了顿，还是叫道：“小辞，对于这位先生所言，两位有什么话想说的？”
郁默勋笑了下，看着叶秋雨，说道：“如果我说我们问心无愧呢？叶先生你又想说什么？”
郁默勋说完，不等台下众人有反应，叶秋雨就笑了：“问心无愧，哈哈哈哈，好一个问心无愧。”
说完，他看着郁默勋，又看向容辞，之后，又把视线放回了郁默勋身上：“郁总，您还真是……足够护着她啊。”
郁默勋眼神坚定，语气也同样坚定：“当然。”

台下众人闻言，又是“哇”的一声。
说实话，郁默勋不肯认也是在大家的意料之内。
毕竟，要真认了，一切就没有挽回的余地了。
但郁默勋这面不改色，分毫不乱的镇定模样，还是让他有些大开眼界。
想起当初进入长墨的初衷，想起曾经公事的日子，他笑得很是讽刺：“郁总，我似乎，从来没有了解过您。”

Volume 1 Chapter 649 We have a clear conscience (Page 1)
Seeing the reactions of Dr. Lu and everyone in the audience, Ye Qiuyu's smile did not diminish, but his eyes were cold. He looked straight at Rong Ci and said, "Yeah, everyone knows it's impossible, right? But someone just did it!"
Ye Qiuyu said the words "I did it" one word at a time, with no concealment of the sarcasm on his face and tone.
After hearing this, everyone naturally understood that Ye Qiuyu wanted to tell everyone that Rong Ci's method of entering Changmo was unfair. She was not as good as everyone thought, and the papers she published were not written by her at all.
Whether Rong Ci is as good as everyone thinks, it doesn't seem to have much to do with outsiders as long as it doesn't affect the cooperation between the two parties.
If the papers published by Rong Ci were all written by Yu Moxun himself or by others, this would involve academic fraud.
Some people couldn't help but say: "Actually, when Rong Ci's first paper came out, some people on the Internet had already questioned her strength. Many people thought that Yu Moxun wrote it for his girlfriend in order to flatter her, but many people also felt that Yu Moxun should not be so confused. After all, he is a serious student of Academician Nan. If things get serious, not only him, but also Academician Nan will be affected to a certain extent."
Before, everyone thought that Yu Moxun could not be so confused, but if everyone hears this now, if what they heard just now is true, then it seems that it is not impossible for Yu Moxun to ghostwrite the paper for Rong Ci...
As for Rong Ci, they really didn't expect her to be so ambitious and capable.
At this time, someone couldn't help but say: "It turns out that there is still such a past between Yu Moxun, Rong Ci, and Lin Wu. No wonder Dr. Lu found it strange before, saying why Chang Mo and Fengshi have been cooperating for so long and they cooperate so well, but the relationship between Mr. Feng and Yu Moxun seems to have always been indifferent, and they basically have no contact with each other. It turns out..."
"Yeah, who would have thought that there would be such a grudge between them?"
At this point, everyone actually wants to know how Yu Moxun will respond.
At this time, everyone looked at Yu Moxun, including Dr. Lu.
Finally, it was Dr. Lu who spoke: "Mr. Yu." After a pause, he still shouted: "Xiao Ci, what do you two want to say about what this gentleman said?"
Yu Moxun smiled, looked at Ye Qiuyu, and said, "What if I say that we have a clear conscience? What do you want to say, Mr. Ye?"
After Yu Moxun finished speaking, before everyone in the audience could react, Ye Qiuyu laughed: "You have a clear conscience, hahahaha, what a clear conscience."
After speaking, he looked at Yu Moxun, then at Rong Ci, and then returned his gaze to Yu Moxun: "Mr. Yu, you are really... enough to protect her."
Yu Moxun's eyes were firm and his tone was equally firm: "Of course."
When everyone in the audience heard this, they said "Wow" again.
To be honest, it was expected that Yu Moxun refused to admit it.
After all, if you really admit it, there will be no room for redemption.
But Yu Moxun's calm and undisturbed look still opened his eyes a bit.
Recalling his original intention of joining Changmo and his business days, he smiled sarcastically: "Mr. Yu, I seem to have never understood you."
